passages.text: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied: “Dominion and awe belong to God; He establishes harmony in the heights of heaven.
passages.sermon:
Bildad was a Shuhite.
Bildad replied.
God holds all dominion.
God inspires awe.
God creates peace in the highest heavens.
passages.original: וַ֭יַּעַן בִּלְדַּ֥ד הַשֻּׁחִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ הַמְשֵׁ֣ל וָפַ֣חַד עִמּ֑וֹ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו׃

passages.text: Can His troops be numbered? On whom does His light not rise?
passages.sermon:
God rules over all things.
God commands countless hosts.
No one can count God's armies.
God's light shines on everyone.
No person escapes God's light.
passages.original: הֲיֵ֣שׁ מִ֭סְפָּר לִגְדוּדָ֑יו וְעַל־ מִ֝֗י לֹא־ יָק֥וּם אוֹרֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: How then can a man be just before God? How can one born of woman be pure?
passages.sermon:
Bildad the Shuhite spoke to Job.
Bildad described God.
God rules over all things.
God inspires awe.
God establishes peace in heaven.
Bildad asked about people.
No person can be truly just before God.
No one born of a woman can be completely pure.
passages.original: וּמַה־ יִּצְדַּ֣ק אֱנ֣וֹשׁ עִם־ אֵ֑ל וּמַה־ יִּ֝זְכֶּ֗ה יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: If even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in His sight, how much less man, who is but a maggot, and the son of man, who is but a worm!”
passages.sermon:
God is holy and perfect.
Even the moon does not shine before Him.
The stars are not pure in His sight.
People are much less pure than the stars.
A man is like a maggot before God.
A human being is like a worm before God.
passages.original: הֵ֣ן עַד־ יָ֭רֵחַ וְלֹ֣א יַאֲהִ֑יל וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים לֹא־ זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃ אַ֭ף כִּֽי־ אֱנ֣וֹשׁ רִמָּ֑ה וּבֶן־ אָ֝דָ֗ם תּוֹלֵעָֽה׃פ
